purpose: Replace the authored leaning rest pose with one upright, centered, front-facing portrait. No runtime rest-pose shear or whole-body rotation.
rendering: One coherent portrait with local painted eye/lip/brow residuals. Hair/ears and facial features follow one rigid head transform; only the neck attachment blends back to the fixed body. Source-crop content can clip during movement.
preparation: Generated square images normalized to 512x512 with native Canvas drawImage. brows-clean.png is the same underpainting as clean.png; only fitted local regions are read. mouth.png is reused byte-for-byte from painted-v0.1; the painter maps its contour into the authored visible mouth travel.

prompts.source: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this existing square painted orange fox avatar portrait. This is a precise production correction for its neutral animation pose. Preserve the SAME fine anime painted illustration, rich amber eyes, orange hair/fur strands, cream muzzle, ivory Chinese stand collar, dark blue constellation robe, star medallion, warm flat cream background and square close face-and-shoulders crop. The portrait must now look completely STRAIGHT UPRIGHT, relaxed, directly FRONT FACING: head centered over the neck, vertical head/neck/shirt centerline, BOTH shoulders at the same height, symmetric upright collar, vertical shirt fasteners. NO head tilt, no sloping shoulders, no sideways neck or leaning torso. Correct the original posture rather than simply rotating the whole canvas. Keep the FACE geometry and size as close to the reference as possible, with the two open amber eyes at identical height: approximate on 512-square coordinates left eye center (185,215), right eye center (332,215), nose (277,254), small gently smiling CLOSED mouth centered (267,284), chin (264,343). Keep these facial regions in their existing positions and scale for rig compatibility; do not redesign eyes/mouth or simplify detail. Change principally neck/collar/shoulder posture below chin, and only the tiny residual head tilt. New upright shoulder line should be balanced on both sides under the head. Remove the tiny stray wand/star fragment cut off at lower left. NO hands, no props, no new arms, no text, no UI, no border. Keep the original off-white background. Return a single coherent portrait, not parts or panels.
prompts.clean: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied straight, upright square Star Fox portrait. This is an INTERNAL UNDERPAINTING TEXTURE for animation, NOT the final visible character. Keep the exact same square canvas, pose, framing, every hair strand, head outline, nose, neck, collar, body, background, palette and lighting. Do not move or redesign any region. Remove ONLY (1) both eyes, including all lashes, irises, whites and eye contours, (2) both eyebrows, (3) the small closed mouth line. Seamlessly fill ONLY these tiny regions with the same smooth light cream facial fur and matching soft shading. Keep the orange hair crossing the forehead/eyes unchanged. Keep the nose and philtrum. No sockets, dark contours, eyelashes or eye creases remaining. Everything outside eyes, eyebrows and mouth must be unchanged and perfectly aligned with reference. No text, new features, new head tilt, new crop, hands or props. Return one square image, matching input dimensions.

limitations: 512px face/shoulder crop; ear tips outside framing
Manually fitted facial coordinates; arbitrary new portraits need material prep and rebinding
Shallow 2D head deformation only; no hidden-side reconstruction
Basic mouth interior; not phoneme-accurate lip sync
Gaze, arms and body following not implemented in current painter
verification: No browser/camera/device acceptance requested for this correction; product-painter still frames and focused code checks only.
